lines.lyric: Nae binjarireul chaewojwotteon neo
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 빈자리를 채워줬던 너
lines.lyric_translation: You filled up my emptiness

lines.lyric: Geu binjaril chaeul su itteon neo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 빈자릴 채울 수 있던 너
lines.lyric_translation: Only you could fill it up

lines.lyric: Geujeo nae gyeote isseo jun geotmaneurodo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그저 내 곁에 있어 준 것만으로도
lines.lyric_translation: Just by being by my side

lines.lyric: Naegen himi dwae
lines.lyric_hangul: 내겐 힘이 돼
lines.lyric_translation: You gave me strength

lines.lyric_hangul: 고맙단 말밖에 못 하던 내가 널 향해 손을 내민다
lines.lyric_translation: I couldn’t say anything else but thank you / But now I’m reaching my hand out to you

lines.lyric_hangul: 그 손을 잡은 너와 함께 전보다 더 큰 꿈을 외친다
lines.lyric_translation: With you, who has taken my hand / I can shout of a bigger dream than before

lines.lyric: Naega neol wihal suman ittamyeon mwodeun hal suga itteorago
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 널 위할 수만 있다면 뭐든 할 수가 있더라고
lines.lyric_translation: If I can live for you, I can do anything

lines.lyric: Neoga deo bitnal suman ittamyeon naega eodumi dwedeorado
lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 더 빛날 수만 있다면 내가 어둠이 되더라도
lines.lyric_translation: If you can shine brighter, I can be the darkness

lines.lyric: Neoye gyeote naega isseo julge
lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 곁에 내가 있어 줄게
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll stay by your side

lines.lyric: Nawa gateun gose isseo jullae
lines.lyric_hangul: 나와 같은 곳에 있어 줄래
lines.lyric_translation: Will you stay in the same place as me?

lines.lyric: Changbakkeun neomu chuwo na honja namaitgien
lines.lyric_hangul: 창밖은 너무 추워 나 혼자 남아있기엔
lines.lyric_translation: It’s too cold to be alone outside

lines.lyric: Yeogin nega isseo ttadeuthae jina bwa
lines.lyric_hangul: 여긴 네가 있어 따듯해 지나 봐
lines.lyric_translation: You’re here, so it’s getting warmer

lines.lyric: I am YOU, I see me in you
lines.lyric_hangul: I am YOU, I see me in you
lines.lyric_translation: I am YOU, I see me in you

lines.lyric: Neowa isseul ttae nan al su isseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 너와 있을 때 난 알 수 있어
lines.lyric_translation: I know when I’m with you

lines.lyric: Gateun gonggan sogeseo, gateun shigan sogeseon
lines.lyric_hangul: 같은 공간 속에서, 같은 시간 속에선
lines.lyric_translation: In the same place, in the same time

lines.lyric: Mwodeun igyeo nael su isseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 뭐든 이겨 낼 수 있어
lines.lyric_translation: I can overcome anything

lines.lyric: I found YOU, I found me in you
lines.lyric_hangul: I found YOU, I found me in you
lines.lyric_translation: I found YOU, I found me in you

lines.lyric: Geu aneseo naye moseubi boyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 안에서 나의 모습이 보여
lines.lyric_translation: I can see me in you

lines.lyric: Gateun gonggan sogeseo, gateun shigan sogeseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 같은 공간 속에서, 같은 시간 속에서
lines.lyric_translation: In the same place, in the same time

lines.lyric: Let me run, let me run, let me run along with YOU
lines.lyric_hangul: Let me run, let me run, let me run along with YOU
lines.lyric_translation: Let me run, let me run, let me run along with YOU

lines.lyric: Nado jal mollatteon nae jashineul bichwojwosseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 나도 잘 몰랐던 내 자신을 비춰줬어
lines.lyric_translation: You shined on me when I didn’t even know myself

lines.lyric: Nado nal mollaseo honja hemaeeosseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 나도 날 몰라서 혼자 헤매었어
lines.lyric_translation: I didn’t know and I was lost

lines.lyric: Geunde eoneu sunganbuteo yurichang neomeoro boyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 근데 어느 순간부터 유리창 너머로 보여
lines.lyric_translation: But from some point, I saw through the window

lines.lyric: Nawa gateun shigan gateun harureul bonaegon haeseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 나와 같은 시간 같은 하루를 보내곤 해서
lines.lyric_translation: Because you spent the same time, the same day with me

lines.lyric_hangul: 이제 나의 질문과 너의 대답이 퍼즐처럼 잘 맞거나
lines.lyric_translation: Now my questions and your answers / Fit together like a puzzle

lines.lyric_hangul: 나의 고민들과 너의 고민들의 교집합 점을 다 찾아가
lines.lyric_translation: My worries and your worries / Intersect

lines.lyric_hangul: 우린 환상의 케미 Every moment 모두 완벽해서 그래 함께라면
lines.lyric_translation: Our chemistry is like a fantasy, every moment / Is so perfect when we’re together

lines.lyric_hangul: 너를 통해 나를 보고 너도 나를 통해 너를 보는 멋진 장면
lines.lyric_translation: Through you, I see me and through me / You see yourself, such a great scene
